اشتعلا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَعَلَا (ištaʕalā) /iʃ.ta.ʕa.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اُشْتُعِلَا (uštuʕilā) /uʃ.tu.ʕi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اِشْتَعِلَا (ištaʕilā) /iʃ.ta.ʕi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
